target.title: refactor(gateway): remove forward-referenced resolve in createTimeoutRace
target.body:
Closes #106645

## What Problem This Solves

Removes a brittle code smell in the gateway shutdown path. `createTimeoutRace` in `src/gateway/server-close.ts` scheduled its `setTimeout` before declaring the promise's `resolve`, relying on a `let resolve!` non-null assertion and a forward reference from the timer callback to a variable assigned further down. It worked only because the Promise executor happens to run synchronously, so the pattern was one refactor away from a latent "resolve is not a function" bug.

## Why This Change Was Made

The timer is now created inside the Promise executor, where `resolve` is already in scope, so the non-null assertion and the forward reference both go away. Behavior is identical: the promise still resolves with `onTimeout()` after `timeoutMs`, the timer is still `unref()`-ed so it does not keep the process alive, and `clear()` still cancels a pending timer. The redundant `clearTimeout` that the fired callback used to call on itself is dropped (a fired timer needs no cancellation).

## User Impact

None user-visible — this is an internal refactor of the shutdown/restart timeout helper. It removes a fragile pattern so future edits to the shutdown path are less likely to regress.

## Evidence

**Real gateway runs on this branch** (`openclaw gateway run --dev --port 18999` with an isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, macOS, Node 22.22.2), exercising both `createTimeoutRace` outcomes:

1. Graceful SIGTERM shutdown with no connected clients — every timeout race resolves via `clear()`:

```
[gateway] ready
[gateway] signal SIGTERM received
[gateway] received SIGTERM; shutting down
[shutdown] started: gateway stopping
[shutdown] completed cleanly in 96ms
```
Port 18999 confirmed free after exit.

2. Graceful SIGTERM shutdown with a live WebSocket client held open — the websocket-close grace race actually fires its `onTimeout` path (`WEBSOCKET_CLOSE_GRACE_MS` = 1000ms) and shutdown continues normally:

```
ws client: connected
[gateway] signal SIGTERM received
[shutdown] started: gateway stopping
[shutdown] websocket server close exceeded 1000ms; forcing shutdown continuation with 1 tracked client(s)
[shutdown] completed in 1089ms with warnings: websocket-server
ws client: closed code=1006
```
Port 18999 confirmed free after exit; the client observed the server-initiated close.

**Automated coverage** — the existing shutdown suite drives every `createTimeoutRace` call site (grace/force websocket close, restart persistence waits, dispose timeouts):

```
pnpm test src/gateway/server-close.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  84 passed (84)

pnpm tsgo:core   # clean
```

`git diff --numstat`: `7  11  src/gateway/server-close.ts` (net -4 lines).

Note: contributor checkout without Crabbox/Testbox access; the runs above are real local gateway processes on this branch.
